actions.action: Unpot plant and inspect roots and corm
Trim rotten roots with clean scissors if present
Repot into chunky mix (perlite/bark/pumice, soil, coir) in slightly larger pot
Alternatively set up temporary sphagnum moss or water culture
Move to bright indirect light indoors away from drafts
Check top 2-3 inches of soil with finger before watering
Water when top soil is dry
Inspect leaf undersides for spider mites
Wipe leaves and apply insecticidal soap if mites found

reason: The answer names dense, wet soil and root rot as the bigger issue, alongside sun stress, and its main advice to repot into an airy mix and water less matches the confirmed fix, with nothing harmful.
